Text Normalization</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Clean noise, tags, timestamps</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. '[01:23] Hello!' -> 'Hello!' | '&lt;i&gt;Bonjour&lt;/i&gt;' -> 'Bonjour'</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="45" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_normalization_icon" parent="nlp_normalization" style="shape=image;html=1;imageAspect=0;aspect=fixed;image=https://cdn.simpleicons.org/python;pointerEvents=0;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="32" x="15" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_tokenizer" parent="group_0" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#5c8a49;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS,cursive;fontStyle=0;sketch=1;align=left;spacingLeft=58;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px;">2. spaCy Tokenizer</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Split into sentences/words</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. 'Hello world' -> ['Hello', 'world'] | "don't" -> ["do", "n't"]</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="195" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_tokenizer_icon" parent="nlp_tokenizer" style="shape=image;html=1;imageAspect=0;aspect=fixed;image=https://cdn.simpleicons.org/spacy;pointerEvents=0;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="32" x="15" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_pos_tagger" parent="group_0" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#5c8a49;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS,cursive;fontStyle=0;sketch=1;align=left;spacingLeft=58;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px;">3. POS Tagging</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Context-aware part of speech</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. '... I am learning ...' -> VERB | '... study guide ...' -> NOUN</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="345" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_pos_tagger_icon" parent="nlp_pos_tagger" style="shape=image;html=1;imageAspect=0;aspect=fixed;image=https://cdn.simpleicons.org/spacy;pointerEvents=0;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="32" x="15" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_ner_filter" parent="group_0" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#5c8a49;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS,cursive;fontStyle=0;sketch=1;align=left;spacingLeft=58;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px;">4. NER Filtering</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Exclude names &amp; locations</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. 'London', 'John' -> Excluded | 'Google', 'French' -> Excluded</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="495" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_ner_filter_icon" parent="nlp_ner_filter" style="shape=image;html=1;imageAspect=0;aspect=fixed;image=https://cdn.simpleicons.org/spacy;pointerEvents=0;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="32" x="15" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_lemmatizer" parent="group_0" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#5c8a49;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS,cursive;fontStyle=0;sketch=1;align=left;spacingLeft=58;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px;">5. Lemmatizer</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Extract dictionary base form</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. 'studies' -> 'study' | 'went' -> 'go'</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="645" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_lemmatizer_icon" parent="nlp_lemmatizer" style="shape=image;html=1;imageAspect=0;aspect=fixed;image=https://cdn.simpleicons.org/spacy;pointerEvents=0;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="32" x="15" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_aggregator" parent="group_0" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#5c8a49;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS,cursive;fontStyle=0;sketch=1;align=left;spacingLeft=58;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px;">6. Vocab Aggregator</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Group unique lemmas &amp; counts</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. ['study', 'study'] -> count=2 | ['go', 'went', 'go'] -> count=3</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="795" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_aggregator_icon" parent="nlp_aggregator" style="shape=image;html=1;imageAspect=0;aspect=fixed;image=https://cdn.simpleicons.org/python;pointerEvents=0;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="32" width="32" x="15" y="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_cefr_scorer" parent="group_0" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#5c8a49;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e293b;fontFamily=Comic Sans MS,cursive;fontStyle=0;sketch=1;align=left;spacingLeft=58;" value="<span style="font-size: 12px;">7. CEFR Grading</span><br><span style="font-size: 11px;">Assign difficulty per lemma</span><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic; color: #666666;">e.g. 'study' -> A2 (Candidate) | 'extraordinary' -> B2 (Candidate)</span>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="450" x="45" y="945" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="nlp_cefr_scorer_icon" parent="nlp_cefr_scorer"
